svg.aria-label: Addressing modes. (a) Immediate: the operand is in the instruction. (b) Direct: the address field points to the operand in memory. (c) Indirect: the address field points to a memory word that holds the operand's address. (d) Register: the field names a register holding the operand. (e) Register indirect: the named register holds the operand's memory address. (f) Displacement: a register's contents plus the address field give the operand's address. (g) Stack: the operand is implicitly on top of the stack
